extra.final_summary: Question: average unit price per category. Category labels were clean per the rules file (no variants/misspellings); no missing values in Price or Category. Result (68 rows): Electronics $351.43, Furniture $153.25, Accessories $31.79, Office Supplies $9.69. Caveats: 3 missing Region values left alone (unused column); Revenue formula not validated since Revenue wasn't used.
